hypotheses.V1_destination_partition_is_numerically_: The three destination groups recompose changed attention writes with maximum relative L2 error at most 1e-6 and propagated-logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.V2_final_write_has_little_state_energy: Final-position state projection is at most 0.05 at every layer, distance, and corpus.
hypotheses.V3_final_write_dominates_baseline_fisher: Final-position insertion Shapley is at least 0.50 under baseline Fisher geometry in every condition.
hypotheses.V4_final_write_dominates_all_behavioral_: Final-position allocation is at least 0.50 under baseline Fisher, changed Fisher, forward KL, and target-error KL in every condition.
hypotheses.V5_insertion_and_removal_preserve_final_: Final-position Fisher Shapley is at least 0.50 in both base-context insertion and changed-context removal games in every condition.
hypotheses.V6_state_behavior_inversion_is_large: Final-position behavioral allocation exceeds its state projection by at least 0.40 in every condition.
hypotheses.V7_final_bottleneck_strengthens_with_dep: For every corpus and edit position, final-position baseline-Fisher allocation at Layer 10 is at least that at Layer 5 minus 0.05.
hypotheses.V8_dominant_destination_transfers_ood: The same destination group has largest absolute allocation under every metric, layer, and edit position across all three corpora.
